Connect Zankup to an AI assistant to ask it about your training, sleep and form from its own app, with your own subscription. It can only read: it never changes anything nor sees your routes or personal details.
In Claude, open Settings → Connectors and tap \"Add custom connector\".
Call it Zankup, paste the address and tap \"Add\".
Tap \"Connect\": Zankup opens; sign in if asked and tap \"Allow\".
Open a chat in Claude and ask about your training.
Any MCP-compatible assistant can use the same address. If it cannot connect by itself, create a personal token in Settings → Zankup Coach and MCP and paste it into its configuration.

Connecting an assistant lets it read your Zankup activities, metrics, sleep and estimates, as numbers and without locations. You can disconnect it at any time: revoke its token in Settings → Zankup Coach and MCP, or remove it from the assistant\'s connectors.
